 LIVE: PSG vs Olympique Lyon | Ligue 1
 Paris Saint-Germain and Olympique Lyonnais meet in a crucial Ligue 1 showdown, with both teams level on points at the top of the standings. The highly anticipated clash has been rescheduled for Monday, October 26, at the Parc des Princes.
 Watch PSG vs Lyon LIVE on beIN SPORTS 
 PSG vs Lyon: How and Where to Watch the Match LIVE 
 Paris Saint-Germain will host Olympique Lyonnais on Monday, October 26, for Matchday 8 of the 2026-27 Ligue 1 season. The match will take place at the Parc des Princes in Paris, kicking off at 3:20 PM ET / 12:20 PM PT . Fans can follow the match through beIN SPORTS CONNECT for United States, Puerto Rico and Canada. After seven league matches, Lyon leaded the standings on goal difference, with PSG in second place. Both clubs have 14 points.
 Don’t miss all the excitement of Ligue 1 on beINSPORTS! 
 How PSG Comes Into the Match 
 Paris Saint-Germain enters the encounter enjoying an impressive run of results under Luis Enrique .
 The defending French champion has won its last four Ligue 1 matches, including a 3-1 away victory over Strasbourg on October 17.
 After falling behind in the first half, PSG completed the comeback with goals from Illia Zabarnyi , Ousmane Dembélé , and Désiré Doué .
 The Parisian club then delivered another major performance on the European stage, defeating Barcelona 4-2 at the Parc des Princes on October 20 in the UEFA Champions League .
 However, the victory over Barcelona came at a significant cost. PSG confirmed that Khvicha Kvaratskhelia suffered a torn anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee and will require surgery. Meanwhile, Ousmane Dembélé and Marquinhos are expected to miss several weeks with muscle injuries, while Nuno Mendes will also be unavailable against Lyon . The absences present a major challenge for Luis Enrique ahead of a crucial clash against the Ligue 1 leaders.
 Despite those absences, Luis Enrique's team will look to maintain its momentum and move ahead of its opponent in the standings.
 How Lyon Comes Into the Match 
 Olympique Lyonnais travels to Paris looking to defend its position at the top of the Ligue 1 table.
 The team coached by Paulo Fonseca has recorded four victories, two draws, and just one defeat in its opening seven league matches.
 In its most recent domestic appearance, Lyon defeated Nice 2-1 on October 18.
 After Elye Wahi opened the scoring for the visitors, Pavel Šulc and Tanner Tessmann found the net within four minutes of each other to turn the match around before halftime.
 However, Lyon's European campaign suffered a setback on October 22, when the French side lost 3-0 away to Hoffenheim in the UEFA Europa League .
 The visitors also face selection difficulties, with Loïs Openda sidelined through injury and Keito Nakamura suspended.
 Despite the recent European defeat, Lyon will travel to Paris knowing that a positive result would strengthen its ambitions near the top of the French league.
 PSG vs Lyon: A Battle Between the Ligue 1 Leaders 
 Monday's showdown brings together the teams that occupied the top two positions after seven rounds of the French championship.
 There is also an important recent precedent in Lyon's favor.
 On April 19, 2026 , Lyon defeated PSG 2-1 at the Parc des Princes , with Endrick and Afonso Moreira scoring the visitors' goals.
 That result ended a run of six consecutive victories for PSG against Lyon across all competitions.
 Now, with both teams entering Matchday 8 on 14 points, another intense encounter awaits.
 PSG will attempt to maintain its winning momentum in the league, while Lyon will look to reproduce last season's success in the French capital.
